text:
lina: Quick sync — we need to rebalance partner cohort credits for the CloudMarket launch next month. Current ask from marketplace PM is higher than expected. My initial proposal: 40% marketplace listing/promos, 35% SI onboarding credits, 25% joint announcement/demo support. Need to make this play into the QBR scorecards and tier nominations. @olivia can you confirm budget headroom? :thinking_face:
eric: prefer shifting more to SI onboarding (pipeline >50% driven by SIs this quarter). Can we cut announcement/demo to 15% and move +10% to SI? That helps conversions from PoC -> paid.
jess: marketing needs at least 30% for co-marketing + launch webinars. If announce falls below 25% we lose key demand-gen windows. We can compress some creative spends but not everything.
raj: ops note — onboarding workstreams (SI integrations) need runway. If we increase SI credits we must push some enablement timelines earlier or add a contractor chunk. Capacity isn't infinite this quarter.
olivia: budget check — current MDF-like pool = $500,000 committed for partner ops this FY. Under lina's split (40/35/25) that's: marketplace $200,000, SI $175,000, announce $125,000. If we add a 10% contingency holdback (recommended) net available = $450,000 -> marketplace $180k, SI $157.5k, announce $112.5k. If we reweight to eric's ask (40/45/15) numbers become marketplace $180k, SI $202.5k, announce $67.5k after 10% holdback.
chris: legal flags — any increase in SI onboarding credits that touch revenue share / co-sell requires an MSA addendum + new co-marketing terms. That's typically a 7-10 business day review if we reuse existing templates; faster if we limit to promotional credits only. Also need partner logos/claim approvals for joint announce.
lina: good to know. For QBR deck we need a single recommended split and contingency plan (A/B). Can we agree to two options by EOD Thu? Option A = lina's original w/10% holdback. Option B = marketing-heavy compromise (35% marketplace / 35% marketing / 30% SI) with conditional funnel triggers (if SI pipeline hits $X then reallocate).
eric: +1 for Option B if we add a gating metric: >= 6 SI-signed LOIs before we shift extra credits.
jess: agreed on gating metric. Also request a co-marketing checklist so we can estimate creative and paid media needs. small sample line items below for modeling:
```
line_item,est_cost
launch-webinar,12000
paid-social,40000
co-branded-demo,15000
si-integration-eng-hours,28000
```
raj: ops will map out resource impact and estimated contractor hours by Monday. Will also flag any capacity constraints that require delaying a launch week.
olivia: finance note — if we commit >60% of the pool to SI onboarding now we reduce runway for surprise partner escalations. Recommend keeping at least $50k unallocated as a rapid-response pot.
chris: I'll draft the MSA addendum template and circulate by Tue morning. If marketing wants logo usage faster, send approved assets to legal channel and we'll fast-track.
lina: thanks team. Action items: 1) olivia — confirm final numbers and contingency by Tue EOD; 2) raj — ops capacity plan by Mon; 3) jess — co-marketing checklist + media estimate by Wed; 4) chris — legal templated addendum Tue AM; 5) eric/jess/lina decide final split and gating metric by Thu EOD for QBR. I'll drop the recommend option into the QBR deck once we have numbers. Link to working doc: https://rwd.in/partnerships/qbr-cohort-plan :point_up:
announce-bot: reminder set — "Partner cohort credits decision" on Thu at 5:00pm PST. :bell:
lina: :thumbsup: if you saw this and are on board, please react or reply with any blocking concerns.
eric: :thumbsup:
jess: noted, will post checklist later today.
olivia: confirming I'll firm up the numbers and a conservative stress test report by Tue.
raj: will carve out time and post capacity heatmap Monday.
chris: will post draft addendum first thing Tue.
lina: great — closing thread for now, will follow up with deck update."
